banksets.title: Ambient
banksets.author: Key & Cable
banksets.description: Twelve slow instruments for a quiet room, one for each bank, each a way of letting the minichord ring: a glass harmonica, singing bowls, a night tanpura, a rain garden, Orwell's scale in 31 tones, tape loops, a breathing pad, a whale, a music box, a handpan, a starlight arpeggio and a deep field.

presets.name: Glass Harmonica
presets.blurb: Glasses that sing. Rest fingers on the strings and lift them to set the glasses ringing; press a ringing one harder and its pitch rises, as a wet finger pressing does, and eases back as you let off. Hold a hand over the plate and each glass swells in slowly instead of sounding at once. The chord bu…

presets.name: Singing Bowls
presets.blurb: A room of singing bowls. The harp is a set of small bowls in a pentatonic, struck as your fingers lift, each ringing with a slow beat; press a ringing bowl and its note rises, up to a tone, as a rim pressed harder does. The chord buttons strike the big bowls, root and fifth, humming for seconds. Un…

presets.name: Night Tanpura
presets.blurb: A tanpura, its strings buzzing and blooming on the jawari bridge, and a bansuri flute on the harp in raga Bhoop, swelling as you press and slurring as you tap beside a held note. The mod knob is the thread under the strings: slide it in and they close to a plain pluck, out and they sing. A soft har…

presets.name: Rain Garden
presets.blurb: Tap hold and it rains: the chord's notes fall one at a time, a drop here and there across two bars, each into an echo, and the garden grows as a hand comes down over the plate. The harp is a set of rain bells answering from side to side. Double tap and the cycle shortens to twelve drops, so the rai…

presets.name: Orwell Nine
presets.blurb: A scale from another arithmetic: thirty-one notes to the octave, nine of them on the strings, stacked from a small third that twelve-tone music doesn't have. Rest fingers on the strings and lift them into a long echo. The chord buttons are a pad in the same tuning, its thirds almost pure. The mod k…

presets.name: Tape Loops
presets.blurb: A pad on worn tape, its pitch wandering and its level fluttering, with a felted electric piano in a long echo on the harp. A hand over the plate saturates the tape. Double tap to record eight bars of piano onto a loop of tape, as played, and double tap to play it round while you add another layer.…

presets.name: Breathing Pad
presets.blurb: A pad that breathes in and out every eight seconds, with a vowel in it. Lower a hand over the plate and the breathing quickens, gradually, as a body does. The harp is a soft lead that swells as you press and holds the loudest you've pressed until you let go. Tap the modifier and hold it and the pad…

presets.name: Whale Song
presets.blurb: A whale on the ribbon: slide a finger along the strip and a low voice glides slowly after it, swelling as you press, echoing away across the water. The chord buttons are the ocean, a low drone that slowly swells and settles, sliding from chord to chord. A hand over the plate sends the song further…

presets.name: Music Box
presets.blurb: A music box. The harp is its comb of tines, two octaves up, sounding as your fingers lift from the strings the way a pin lets a tine go; the chord buttons are its tiny accompaniment, and in rhythm mode it plays a waltz. Hold a hand over the plate and the box winds down, slowing toward a stop; lift…

presets.name: Handpan
presets.blurb: A handpan: the harp's strings are its tone fields in the Kurd scale, ringing long with a slow shimmer, as loud as they're struck; the chord buttons are the ding and the low note under it. Lay a hand flat to damp. A hand over the plate opens it into a long room. Tap hold for a soft 12/8 on hand drum…

presets.name: Starlight Arp
presets.blurb: Tap hold and sine bells climb and fall slowly through the held chord, each hanging in an echo. The harp is a soft pad you place rather than play: rest fingers on the strings to choose the notes and lift them to let each bloom in. A hand over the plate lets the bells hang longer. Double tap and the…

presets.name: Deep Field
presets.blurb: The deepest, slowest one. A low drone on the key hums under everything; the chord buttons are a sub pad that takes three seconds to arrive and five to leave, sliding from chord to chord, tuned pure; the harp is a bowed voice that swells as you press and echoes into the dark. A hand over the plate b…

banksets.title: Classical
banksets.author: Key & Cable
banksets.description: Twelve presets through the history of written music, one for each bank, stepping forward in time as the up button steps through the banks: medieval organum, a Renaissance consort, a choir in 31-tone temperament, a harpsichord and a cathedral organ in Werckmeister's tuning, a fortepiano in Vallotti's, a string quartet, a celesta waltz, a small orchestra, a concert harp, a Spanish guitar and a string orchestra's adagio.

presets.name: Organum
presets.blurb: Medieval chant in parallel fifths and octaves: each chord button sets a choir singing the root, the fifth and the octave together, moving as one, in the pure fifths of Pythagorean tuning, over a low drone on the final. The harp is a cantor in the Dorian mode, singing the line the choir follows. A h…

presets.name: Renaissance Consort
presets.blurb: A lute over a consort of viols, in quarter-comma meantone, the tuning of the sixteenth century, whose major thirds ring pure (the keys around C are sweetest, the far ones sour, as they were). The viols move in strict four-part counterpoint. Double tap for the suspensions every cadence of the time l…

presets.name: Cantus Choir
presets.blurb: From gen2, as it is there.

presets.name: Harpsichord
presets.blurb: A harpsichord with a cello on the bass line, the basso continuo of a Baroque ensemble, in Werckmeister III, the well-tempered tuning of Bach's time. Like the real one it plays every note at one loudness. Rhythm mode runs a prelude's broken chords, the cello holding underneath. A hand over the plate…

presets.name: Cathedral Organ
presets.blurb: A pipe organ in a stone church: flue pipes speaking at eight, four and sixteen feet with a breath of wind, in Werckmeister III, under a long reverb. The harp plays a solo flute stop on a second manual, sounding as long as it is held. A hand over the plate opens the swell box; double tap for the ple…

presets.name: Fortepiano Sonata
presets.blurb: A fortepiano of Mozart's time, in Vallotti's temperament: in rhythm mode the chord buttons play an Alberti bass, the left hand of a classical sonata, while the harp plays the melody with dynamics. A hand over the plate lifts the dampers; double tap for the moderator, a felt between hammers and stri…

presets.name: Chamber Strings
presets.blurb: From gen2, as it is there.

presets.name: Celesta Waltz
presets.blurb: A celesta over a pizzicato string orchestra in three: the sugar-plum bell tone on the harp, high and glassy, ringing over a waltz in rhythm mode. A hand over the plate brightens the strings; double tap for a glockenspiel, an octave higher.

presets.name: Pocket Orchestra
presets.blurb: From gen2, as it is there.

presets.name: Concert Harp
presets.blurb: From gen2, as it is there.

presets.name: Spanish Guitar
presets.blurb: A concert guitar in nylon strings: pluck harder or strum faster to play louder, hold a string and tap the next for the left hand's slurs, lay the palm across to damp. The chord buttons are a second guitar, strummed, over a rumba on hand percussion in rhythm mode.

presets.name: Adagio for Strings
presets.blurb: A string orchestra, slow and wide: chords swell in, tuned pure as the players tune by ear, and slide into the next when you roll your fingers from one chord to the next, a section's portamento. The harp is a solo violin over it, swelling as you press. A hand over the plate is the crescendo.

banksets.title: Drum and Bass
banksets.author: Key & Cable
banksets.description: Twelve presets through drum and bass, one for each bank, all at 168-174 bpm: liquid, amen jungle, Reese neuro, atmospheric, jump-up, halftime, vocal chops, a minimal roller, jazzstep, rave stabs, ragga jungle and a finger-drum jungle lab.

presets.name: Liquid Roller
presets.blurb: Liquid drum and bass: a chorused Rhodes in ninth chords over a deep sine sub, a vibraphone on the harp echoing across the stereo field, and a rolling two-step underneath. A hand over the plate deepens the chorus; double tap for the plain chords.

presets.name: Amen Jungle
presets.blurb: Jungle: the amen-style break at 170 on a dusty kit, a sine sub that slides when you roll from one button to the next, and an orchestra stab on the harp. Double tap and the harp becomes the kit, so you can chop the break yourself over the groove.

presets.name: Reese Neuro
presets.blurb: Neurofunk: a Reese bass, two sawtooths a hair apart beating against each other with a third an octave below, driven hard through a resonant filter that a slow LFO keeps moving. Your hand over the plate opens it. A sharp, metallic stab on the harp, a two-step on a glitchy kit.

presets.name: Atmospheric
presets.blurb: Atmospheric drum and bass: a choir pad breathing in slowly over a deep sub, a soft flute-like lead on the harp ribbon gliding through the chord's scale, echoes and a big reverb, over a think-style break. A hand over the plate swells the choir.

presets.name: Jump Up
presets.blurb: Jump-up: a wobble bass, its filter swung by the LFO, with the mod knob taking it from a lurch to eighth notes at 174, over a two-step on a 909. The harp is a short, bright stab. A hand over the plate opens the wobble up.

presets.name: Halftime
presets.blurb: Halftime: the drums at half the tempo's feel, a trap kit whose kick is an 808 on the root of the chord you hold, a dark pad sliding between chords as you roll them, and a bell lead on the harp echoing in triplets. A hand over the plate opens the pad.

presets.name: Vocal Chops
presets.blurb: Chopped vocals: the harp is a choir cut short, each touch a syllable bouncing across the stereo field in the echo, louder as you hit harder, over strings and a sub on the chord buttons and a two-step. Hold the modifier and lower a hand to stretch the chops out.

presets.name: Minimal Roller
presets.blurb: A minimal roller: a sub that holds on the root, a quiet Reese whisper above it, a two-step on the dusty kit with its rimshots, and a short pluck on the harp feeding a long, dark echo. The mod knob takes the echo from a single repeat to a dub trail; a hand over the plate throws the pluck into it.

presets.name: Jazzstep
presets.blurb: Jazzstep: an upright bass walking fast on the chords' bass note, a Rhodes comping above, a vibraphone on the harp, over a think-style break at 172. Double tap for ninths; a hand over the plate holds the Rhodes' sustain.

presets.name: Rave Stabs
presets.blurb: Early-nineties rave into jungle: piano stabs on the chord buttons, short and punchy, a hoover-ish detuned lead on the harp ribbon swooping between notes, over the amen at 168. A hand over the plate opens the piano up.

presets.name: Ragga Jungle
presets.blurb: Ragga jungle: the amen at 168 with a dub sub underneath, a melodica on the harp that swells as you press, and dub throws: lower a hand to send the melodica into the echo, tap the modifier and hold it for the wash. A soundsystem in a box.

presets.name: Finger Jungle
presets.blurb: Finger-drummed jungle: the harp's strings are the dusty kit's pads, kick lowest, as hard as you hit them, and the looper keeps what you play: double tap, wait through a bar of clicks, play two bars, and it loops, pulled onto the sixteenths at 172. The chord buttons are a sliding sub. Start rhythm m…

banksets.title: Electric Piano
banksets.author: Key & Cable
banksets.description: Twelve electric pianos and their cousins, one for each bank, each set in the music it belongs to: a stage Rhodes, a suitcase with its tremolo, a Wurlitzer, an eighties FM tine, neo-soul keys with a bass, a jazz trio, a vibraphone quartet, a Rhodes through a wah, a Rhodes in the rain, fusion with a synth lead, Lo-fi Study from Gen 3, and a late-night duo of Rhodes and vibes.

presets.name: Stage Rhodes
presets.blurb: A stage Rhodes on both sides, voice-led like a pianist's left hand, its tines barking when played hard. A hand over the plate holds the sustain pedal down; double tap for ninths and 6/9s. Rhythm mode is a soul ballad with a pickup and an ending.

presets.name: Suitcase Tremolo
presets.blurb: A suitcase Rhodes with its tremolo running, the sound of seventies soft rock: chords pulsing in the stereo field, the harp pulsing with them. The mod knob is the tremolo's depth. Tap the modifier and hold it and the tremolo speeds up, gliding to its new rate and back as you let go.

presets.name: Wurli
presets.blurb: A Wurlitzer electric piano: reedy, with a bark on every strike that growls when you hit it hard, its built-in tremolo shimmering. The harp is the same instrument, round when plucked softly and barking when plucked hard. Rhythm mode rolls a boogie over a shuffle.

presets.name: Tine '84
presets.blurb: The eighties' FM electric piano: a glassy sine with a bright metallic tine on every strike, chorused wide, the harp chiming two octaves of bell above each note. Rhythm mode is a power ballad on an 808, with a pickup and an ending.

presets.name: Neo-Soul Keys
presets.blurb: Neo-soul: a chorused Rhodes in ninth and eleventh-flavoured chords on every button, a fingered bass under it playing the line in rhythm mode, and a loose, laid-back beat behind. A hand over the plate deepens the chorus; double tap for the plain chords.

presets.name: Rhodes Trio
presets.blurb: A jazz trio with a Rhodes in the piano chair: an upright bass walking on the chords' bass note (the sampled upright), the Rhodes comping above it, brushes on a swing ride, and the harp a Rhodes for the right hand's lines. A fill takes the trio into a bossa nova and back.

presets.name: Vibes Quartet
presets.blurb: A vibraphone over piano, upright bass and brushes: the vibes ring and shimmer with their motor on until you damp them, flat-handed or by lifting the hand that holds the pedal down. Rhythm mode is a bossa nova; a fill swings it.

presets.name: Wah Rhodes
presets.blurb: A Rhodes through a wah pedal over a funk groove: the chord buttons stab in sixteenths in rhythm mode, your hand over the plate works the wah, and the harp is a synth bass that hammers on and slides. Double tap to loop two bars, counted in and pulled onto the sixteenths.

presets.name: Rain Rhodes
presets.blurb: A Rhodes in a big, wet space, for slow, open chords: every note echoes across the stereo field and fades into a long reverb, the chords tuned a little toward just intonation so they sit still. Hold a hand over the plate to throw the chords into the echo; double tap to loop four bars and play over y…

presets.name: Fusion Lead
presets.blurb: Jazz-rock fusion: a chorused Rhodes comping on the chord buttons, and on the harp a monosynth lead on the ribbon over two octaves, sawtooth through a resonant filter, gliding between the notes of the scale that fits each chord. Press harder to open it up. Rhythm mode is a funk beat with the bass un…

presets.name: Lo-fi Study
presets.blurb: From gen3, as it is there.

presets.name: Late Night Duo
presets.blurb: A duo for the last set of the night: a soft, dark Rhodes on the chord buttons and a vibraphone on the harp, brushes barely there in rhythm mode. A hand over the plate holds the Rhodes' sustain pedal; double tap and the harp turns to Rhodes too.

banksets.title: Folk & Americana
banksets.author: Key & Cable
banksets.description: Twelve instruments from the front porch, one for each bank, each played the way its players play it: an autoharp (the Omnichord's own ancestor), a Travis-picked guitar, a bluegrass banjo, a mandolin, a mountain dulcimer, a pedal steel, a blues harp, a honky-tonk piano, a washboard band, a Cajun accordion, a Celtic harp and a campfire singalong.

presets.name: Autoharp
presets.blurb: The autoharp, the instrument the Omnichord grew out of: every string plays the chord you hold, and they sound as your fingers leave them. Rest fingers on the strings and lift them for a roll, or sweep a finger across for a strum. A hand held over the plate is the felt damper: the strings' ring shor…

presets.name: Travis Guitar
presets.blurb: A steel-string guitar: the chord buttons strum it, with a sampled upright bass on the bass note, and the harp is the same guitar an octave down, with hammer-ons and pull-offs. In rhythm mode the thumb picks the alternating bass of Travis picking under the fingers' chords. Double tap for a capo on t…

presets.name: Bluegrass Banjo
presets.blurb: A five-string banjo on the harp, bright and popping, high up, with a flat-picked guitar and upright bass on the chord buttons. Strum fast for a roll, hold a string and tap the next for the slurs. A hand over the plate palms the head and chokes the ring. Double tap and the fiddle takes the break: th…

presets.name: Mandolin Waltz
presets.blurb: A mandolin on the harp, bright and quick, over a guitar and upright bass in three. Hold a hand over the plate and the mandolin tremolo-picks: every held note shimmers, as deep as the hand is near. Hold a string and tap the next for a slur. Double tap for the mandola, an octave down.

presets.name: Mountain Dulcimer
presets.blurb: An Appalachian dulcimer: the harp is the melody string in the mixolydian mode of the DAD tuning, and the chord buttons are its drone strings, root and fifth, humming on. Pluck a string by lifting a finger from it, then press it with another finger and it slides up a fret, as the noter does; ease of…

presets.name: Pedal Steel
presets.blurb: A pedal steel guitar. The harp is the bar: slide a finger along it and the note glides between the chord's tones, louder as you press, the volume pedal under your finger. The chord buttons are the pedals: roll from one chord onto the next, still holding the first, and the chord slides there. A hand…

presets.name: Blues Harp
presets.blurb: A harmonica in the blues scale over a boogie guitar and bass with a shuffle on the drums. Press a note harder and it swells, as breath does; hold one and tap the next for the slur. Cup your hand over the plate and open it: the hovering hand opens and closes the tone, as hands do around the harp. Do…

presets.name: Honky-Tonk
presets.blurb: A tack piano that's seen some nights, a little out of tune with itself, with an upright bass walking under it, playing a boogie in rhythm mode and swinging a shuffle on the kit. The harp is the right hand, in the scale of each chord, and a hand over the plate is its sustain pedal. Press the ringing…

presets.name: Washboard Band
presets.blurb: A jug band. The harp's twelve strings are the kit's pads, played with the fingers: a suitcase kick at the bottom, the washboard's snare and knocks, the spoons, a cymbal lid. The chord buttons are a tub bass with a banjo-uke chop. Double tap to loop two bars of what you tap, counted in with a bar of…

presets.name: Cajun Accordion
presets.blurb: A Cajun button accordion on the chord buttons, its reeds beating a little against each other, with a fiddle on the harp that swells as you press and slurs from note to note. A hand over the plate works the bellows. Rhythm mode is a two-step with the ti-fer's triangle; double tap for the big box, an…

presets.name: Celtic Harp
presets.blurb: A wire-strung harp, ringing long and bright, over a quiet consort of bowed strings. Rest fingers on the strings and they sound as you lift them, as a harper's do; lay the palm across to damp. A hand over the plate opens the strings into a stone hall. In rhythm mode the consort plays a jig. Double t…

presets.name: Campfire Song
presets.blurb: A guitar strumming on the chord buttons and a few voices humming on the harp, swelling as you press. Double tap to record the song's chords into the chord memory while the guitar strums, double tap again and it plays them round on its own, so both hands are free to sing the tune on the strings. A h…

banksets.title: Gen 2 presets
banksets.author: Key & Cable
banksets.description: Twelve presets, one for each bank, each built around something the minichord learnt after its first twelve presets were made.

presets.name: Open Hand Pad
presets.blurb: A warm, chorused analog pad that blooms open, and a glassy harp that ping-pongs across the stereo field. Hold a hand over the harp plate and the pad's filter opens; hold the modifier as well and the pad's chords settle into just intonation, the beating between their notes slowing to stillness. Tap…

presets.name: Concert Harp
presets.blurb: A plucked string model harp, strings fanned out low left to high right as if sitting at it, over a soft string section. The strings are tuned to the scale of each chord, so a sweep is a harpist's glissando, and both tune a little toward just intonation, as an ensemble does by ear. Pluck harder or s…

presets.name: Jazz Piano
presets.blurb: Sampled piano on both sides. The chords voice-lead like a comping pianist, the harp plays the scale that fits each chord, with dynamics, and the double tap turns the buttons into ninths and 6/9s. A hand held over the plate is the sustain pedal. An upright bass plays each chord's bass note; in rhyth…

presets.name: Cantus Choir
presets.blurb: A sampled choir on the chord buttons, in 31-tone equal temperament with purity on, so every chord is sung in just intonation, its fifths pure as well as its thirds, the way a choir tunes by ear, and the root never drifts. The voices move like a choir's, and the first note of each harp gesture becom…

presets.name: Chamber Strings
presets.blurb: A string quartet that keeps strict four-part voice leading, with no parallel fifths or octaves, in 31-tone equal temperament with purity on, so its chords ring pure, fifths and thirds both, as a quartet tunes them. The bass line is plucked under the bowed upper three, and the harp is pizzicato too,…

presets.name: Folk Guitar & Bass
presets.blurb: The chord buttons play a plucked double bass (the sampled upright bass on the bass note alone), the chord's root; the harp is a nylon-string guitar an octave lower than usual. Strum fast for a loud strum, lay the palm across the plate to mute. Hold a string and tap the one beside it for a hammer-on…

presets.name: Wah Clav & Bass
presets.blurb: Funky clavinet chords with a hand-played wah: hold a hand over the plate and move it up and down to sweep the filter. The harp is a plucked synth bass on the minor pentatonic of each chord, the funk bass's scale, with hammer-ons and slides: hold a note and tap the next. The double tap works the loo…

presets.name: Dub Melodica
presets.blurb: Reggae: offbeat skank chords (in rhythm mode) and a melodica on the harp that swells as it is pressed harder, and runs legato from note to note as fingers land beside a held one. Hold a hand over the plate to throw the chords into the echo; hold the modifier as well and the echo runs away with itse…

presets.name: Ribbon Lead
presets.blurb: The harp is a ribbon over two octaves: slide a finger along it and a singing lead glides between the notes of the scale that fits each chord, so it stays in key, tuned a little toward the chord's just intervals. Press harder to swell. A soft pad underneath glides from chord to chord, but only when…

presets.name: Pocket Orchestra
presets.blurb: A small orchestra on the chord buttons: plucked basses, a string quartet in the middle and a choir on the top line, voiced like an arrangement and tuned pure, chord by chord, as an orchestra listens to itself. The mod knob hands the top line to another section: flute, piano, pizzicato, choir or str…

presets.name: Midnight Raga
presets.blurb: A tanpura plucking its four strings over the droned chords, the recorded tabla playing teental on top in rhythm mode, and a ribbon sitar for meend through raga Darbari Kanada, the midnight raga, in a tuning of pure fifths. Every chord button whose root is in the raga makes a drone under it: Sa, Ma,…

presets.name: Talking Strings
presets.blurb: A string machine that talks. With a hand over the plate the strings form vowels, opening from ah to oo as the hand comes down. Double tap for the vocoder: play speech or singing into the minichord over USB (minicontrol's "talk" loop works) and the chords say it. In rhythm mode the arpeggio finds th…

banksets.title: Gen 3 presets
banksets.author: Key & Cable
banksets.description: Twelve more presets, one for each bank, each an instrument and a way of playing it, built on what the minichord learnt in firmware 46-69.

presets.name: Barbershop Ring
presets.blurb: A barbershop quartet on the chord buttons, its lead singing the melody you pick out on the harp while the bass, baritone and tenor harmonize around it. Lower a hand over the plate and the quartet locks its tuning: the chord stops beating and rings, and a seventh chord's seventh drops into the barbe…

presets.name: Sunday Organ
presets.blurb: A tonewheel organ through a rotating speaker, with a gospel piano on the harp. Hold a hand over the plate as the swell pedal. Tap the modifier and hold it down and the speaker spins up to full tremolo for as long as you hold it, spinning back down as you let go. In hold mode, press the ringing chor…

presets.name: Lo-fi Study
presets.blurb: A worn electric piano with ninth chords on the buttons, a soft felt pluck on the harp and a dusty, loose beat. Double tap to record a progression into the chord memory, double tap again and it plays itself, so both hands can noodle on the harp. A hand over the plate muffles everything, as if throug…

presets.name: Play Along
presets.blurb: Play with whatever is on your phone or computer, coming in over USB (USB audio 1). Hold a chord and it stabs along on every kick drum of the song; start rhythm mode and the arpeggio finds the song's beat and locks to it. The pad's filter opens on the song's hi-hats. Lower a hand over the plate to s…

presets.name: Beat Lab
presets.blurb: Finger drums. The harp's twelve strings are the boom bap kit's pads, kick at the bottom, as loud as you hit them, and the chord buttons are a sub bass that slides when you roll from one to the next. Double tap to loop what you play: a bar of clicks, two bars recorded and pulled onto the sixteenths,…

presets.name: Island Steel
presets.blurb: A steel pan on the harp, bright and bell-like, ping-ponging between two pans across the stereo field, over a strummed cuatro and a soca band. Strum fast for a roll. A fill in rhythm mode drops the band into a reggae one drop for a verse, and the next fill brings the soca back.

presets.name: Desert Blues
presets.blurb: A driven electric guitar in the minor pentatonic, played the Saharan way: hold a note and tap the next string for hammer-ons, lift for pull-offs, and lay the palm across to mute. The chord buttons are a droning bass and rhythm guitar on root and fifth. Double tap to loop a riff (a bar counted in),…

presets.name: Rast on Oud
presets.blurb: An oud in maqam Rast, in quarter tones: strum upward and the strings play Rast's way up, with its half-flat E and B; play a falling line and they take the B flat of its way down. Hammer on from a held note for an oud player's ornaments. Double tap to move into Suznak. The chord buttons hold a strin…

presets.name: Yaman at Dusk
presets.blurb: A santoor in raga Yaman, the evening raga, over a tanpura, a soft harmonium on the chord buttons, and the recorded tabla playing kehrwa. Sweep up the strings and they climb Yaman's way up, skipping Pa; sweep down and they fall its way down, through Pa. Everything is tuned in just intonation from Sa…

presets.name: Koto & Sho
presets.blurb: A koto in hirajoshi: rest fingers on the strings and they sound as you lift them; press a ringing string with another finger and it bends up, settling on the semitone and the whole tone, as a koto player presses beside the bridge. Under it a sho, the mouth organ of gagaku, plays shimmering clusters…

presets.name: Bronze Garden
presets.blurb: A gamelan: the harp is a bronze metallophone in slendro, its five notes nearly equal steps apart, ringing long with a slow shimmer, neighbouring strings answering from opposite sides. Lay a hand flat to damp it. The chord buttons strike gongs that hum and beat as they fade (C, D, F, G and A are sle…

presets.name: Highland Pipes
presets.blurb: A pipe chanter on the harp, in the pipes' mixolydian scale, over drones that never stop, and an accordion on the chord buttons, all in just intonation. The chanter can't play louder or softer, like the real one: shape the tune with grace notes instead, holding a note and tapping the one beside it.…

banksets.title: Mallets & Tines
banksets.author: Key & Cable
banksets.description: Twelve presets for the kalimba and the marimba, one for each bank, each the instrument in a music it belongs to, from thumb to mallet as the banks go up: a Shona mbira's two interlocking parts, Konono's distorted likembes, the marimbula under a Cuban tres, Earth, Wind & Fire's kalimba, a looped lo-fi riff and a lullaby; then a griot's balafon in seven equal steps, a Zimbabwean marimba band, the marimba doble of Guatemala, Reich's pulsing mallets, exotica's vibes and marimba, and tropical house.

presets.name: Mbira Bira
presets.blurb: The Shona mbira, as it is played through the night at a bira: two parts that interlock. The chord buttons play the answering part, a kalimba on the offbeats of a 12/8 bell, and the harp is yours to lead on the beats, in the key's scale. Record the cycle of chords into the chord memory with the doub…

presets.name: Electric Likembe
presets.blurb: Konono Nº1 from Kinshasa: thumb pianos through homemade pickups and loudspeakers, distorted, over a relentless dance beat. The harp is the lead likembe, the chord buttons a bass likembe an octave down, arpeggiating in rhythm mode. A hand over the plate pushes the speaker open. Double tap to loop a…

presets.name: Marimbula Son
presets.blurb: Changüí from eastern Cuba, the root of son. The chord buttons are the marimbula, a thumb piano the size of a box that the player sits on: the kalimba an octave down, plucking the bass ahead of the beat as son's bass does. The harp is the tres guitar, bright and metallic; hold a note and tap the nex…

presets.name: Kalimba Soul
presets.blurb: The kalimba Maurice White brought into Earth, Wind & Fire: on the harp, through a dotted echo, over an electric piano comping on the chord buttons with a fingered bass under it, in a funk groove. A hand over the plate is the hand on the kalimba's sound hole, its own wah. Double tap for ninths.

presets.name: Lo-fi Kalimba
presets.blurb: A lo-fi beat: a kalimba riff on the harp, a Wurlitzer struck softly on the chord buttons, round and warm, a dusty, swung beat under them. Double tap to loop two bars of the kalimba, counted in, and play over your own riff. A hand over the plate muffles the chords; with the modifier held, it saturat…

presets.name: Thumb Piano Lullaby
presets.blurb: A kalimba at bedtime. Rest fingers on the strings and lift them to pluck, the way a thumb leaves a tine; a softer kalimba rocks a slow 6/8 under them in rhythm mode. Lower a hand over the plate and the sound hole closes: the tines go dim and round. Double tap for a smaller kalimba, an octave up.

presets.name: Balafon
presets.blurb: The balafon of the Mande griots: wooden keys over gourds whose holes are covered with spider-egg membranes, buzzing on every stroke. The octave is divided into seven nearly equal steps, as on many balafons: the harp plays them, starting on C, and a low balafon answers on the chord buttons. Double t…

presets.name: Marimba Band
presets.blurb: A Zimbabwean marimba band: the chord buttons are the bass marimba, thumping an ostinato that follows each chord, and the harp the soprano marimba's melody over it, with hand drums in a dance beat. The songs cycle through their chords as mbira pieces do: double tap to record the cycle into the chord…

presets.name: Marimba de Guatemala
presets.blurb: The marimba doble of Guatemala, several players at one long keyboard. Its long notes are rolled, the mallets alternating fast on one key: hold a hand over the plate and the harp rolls the notes you hold, lift it for single strokes. The chord buttons are the bass player's end, rocking in 6/8 in rhyt…

presets.name: Reich Pulse
presets.blurb: Steve Reich's mallets: the chord buttons pulse a twelve-note figure on the marimba in steady eighths, and the harp is a vibraphone. Double tap to loop a bar of your own: the loop is eight eighths and the figure twelve, so they slide against each other and line up again every three bars, a phasing b…

presets.name: Exotica
presets.blurb: Martin Denny and Arthur Lyman's Hawaiian lounge: a vibraphone on the harp, ringing with its motor, a marimba comping on the chord buttons, an upright bass on the bass note and a rumba clave on hand drums. A hand over the plate is the lagoon: the vibes sink into the reverb. A fill moves the band int…

presets.name: Tropical Marimba
presets.blurb: Tropical house: short marimba plucks on the offbeats over a four-on-the-floor beat and a sub, and a marimba lead on the harp with a dotted echo. A hand over the plate is a DJ's filter sweep, opening the plucks; with the modifier held it feeds the echo back. Double tap to drop everything but the dru…

banksets.title: Acoustic Piano
banksets.author: Key & Cable
banksets.description: Twelve pianos, one for each bank, each the piano in a music it belongs to, roughly in the order the music came: a concert grand, a classical sonata, a nocturne, Satie's slow waltz, ragtime turning into stride, boogie-woogie, Barry Harris's sixth-diminished blocks, a jazz waltz, a gospel ballad, Glass's arpeggios, a felt piano and a piano on tape.

presets.name: Concert Grand
presets.blurb: A concert grand, both hands: the chord buttons the left, voice-led, the harp the right, louder as you strike harder. A hand over the plate is the sustain pedal; with the modifier held it is the soft pedal, the right hand going hushed. The mod knob opens the lid. Rhythm mode is a ballad's left hand.

presets.name: Sonata Facile
presets.blurb: A classical sonata: rhythm mode plays an Alberti bass, low, high, middle, high, while the harp sings the melody. A hand over the plate takes the left hand from crisp and detached to smooth legato; the mod knob runs the tempo from andante to allegro. Double tap and the sonata becomes a minuet in thr…

presets.name: Nocturne
presets.blurb: A nocturne: the left hand rolls a wide arpeggio in six while the harp sings above it. Lean a hand in over the plate and the music holds back, rubato, and lets go again as you lift away. Double tap for ornaments: a finger landing beside a ringing note takes it over at once, for turns and trills.

presets.name: Gymnopedie
presets.blurb: Satie's slow waltz: the bass on one, the chord on two and three, every major chord a major seventh. Rock between G and D and it is already the first Gymnopedie. A hand over the plate grows the room around the piano, from a parlour to a stone church. Double tap for plain triads.

presets.name: Maple Leaf
presets.blurb: Ragtime to stride: the left hand's boom-chick, bass and chord, straight as Joplin wrote it. Bring a hand over the plate and it swings, a Harlem stride. The harp crushes grace notes into the melody, a finger beside a ringing note taking it over at once. Double tap for stride's sixths and diminished…

presets.name: Boogie Woogie
presets.blurb: A rent party's boogie-woogie, the piano alone: the left hand rolls the eight-to-the-bar bass, the harp rides on top with crushed grace notes. Hold a hand over the plate and the left hand drops an octave into the rumble. Double tap and the bass walks instead.

presets.name: Barry Harris
presets.blurb: Barry Harris's sixth-diminished blocks. Hold a chord and walk the harp: every chord tone gives the sixth chord with that note on top, every note between gives its diminished brother, so a scale is a line of moving blocks. Strike the same string again and the block opens: drop 2, drop 3, drop 2 and…

presets.name: Jazz Waltz
presets.blurb: A piano trio in three: an upright bass under the chords, maj7, m7 and 7 on the button pairs, brushes in a jazz waltz. Raise a hand over the plate and the voicing opens, close to drop 2 to drop 3 to drop 2 and 4, the chords spreading as the solo builds. Double tap and the trio goes into four.

presets.name: Sunday Gospel
presets.blurb: A gospel ballad in a slow twelve-eight. Start alone and bring a hand over the plate: the band comes in behind you, the closer the louder. With hold on, press the ringing chord again and it climbs an inversion, the church pianist's walk up. Double tap for the gospel colours: add9, sus, 6/9.

presets.name: Glass Arpeggios
presets.blurb: Arpeggios turning over and over, as in Philip Glass: the chord climbs and falls in eighths. A hand over the plate takes beats away from the bar, four to three to two, and with the modifier held adds them, five, six, seven, the pattern wrapping to each new length. Move the hand and the music breathe…

presets.name: Felt Piano
presets.blurb: A felt piano, close-miked in a small room: a strip of felt between the hammers and the strings makes it soft and woody. A hand over the plate lifts the felt off the chords, with the modifier off the melody. Double tap to loop what you play and play over it; the mod knob is a quiet echo.

presets.name: Tape Piano
presets.blurb: A piano recorded on a worn cassette, over a lazy beat: soft, a little saturated, wobbling. Bring a hand over the plate and the tape warbles; with the modifier held the piano goes muffled, as if from the next room. The mod knob ages the tape. Double tap for a harder boom bap.

banksets.title: Synth
banksets.author: Key & Cable
banksets.description: Twelve electronic instruments, one for each bank, each a way of playing the minichord as a synthesizer: a synthwave pad, a chiptune, an acid line, a theremin, a trance gate, an 808 beatbox, synth brass, Italo disco, a radio DJ, a Blade Runner pad, a Berlin-school sequence and a power ballad.

presets.name: Neon Pad
presets.blurb: A wide, chorused synthwave pad whose filter opens under the hovering hand, with a ping-ponging pluck on the harp in an echo on the beat. Rhythm mode runs an arpeggio over a held bass on an 808. Tap the modifier and hold it down and the chords turn to suspensions for as long as it is held, resolving…

presets.name: Chip Tune
presets.blurb: An 8-bit console: pulse waves, a square-wave lead that every note plays at one loudness, as a chip does, and in rhythm mode the arpeggio that a chip plays to fake a chord, in sixteenths. A hand over the plate speeds the game up. Double tap and the strings become the drum channel, twelve noise-and-c…

presets.name: Acid Line
presets.blurb: A 303 on the chord buttons: in rhythm mode the bass note runs on every eighth, squelching; a hand over the plate opens its filter, the modifier with it screams the resonance. Roll from one chord onto the next and the line slides there. The harp is a second acid voice in the minor pentatonic that sl…

presets.name: Theremin
presets.blurb: A theremin on the harp: slide a finger along the strip and a sine glides between the notes of the chord's scale; press harder to swell, ease off to fade, the volume antenna under your finger. A hand hovering over the plate shakes vibrato in. The chord buttons are an eerie string pad that slides fro…

presets.name: Trance Gate
presets.blurb: A supersaw pad chopped into sixteenths by a gate, with a pluck on the harp echoing on the dotted eighth. Lower a hand over the plate and the filter closes down for the breakdown. Tap the modifier and hold it down and the gate doubles to thirty-seconds for as long as you hold, slewing there and back…

presets.name: Boombox 808
presets.blurb: An 808 under your fingers: the harp's twelve strings are its pads, kick at the bottom, as hard as you hit them, and the chord buttons hit an orchestra stab with a sine sub under it. Double tap to loop two bars of pads, counted in, pulled onto the sixteenths; tap hold for an electro beat on the same…

presets.name: Synth Brass
presets.blurb: Eighties synth brass: a bite on every press and a scoop up to the pitch, with a lead on the harp that swells as you press and slides as you tap beside a held note. In rhythm mode the brass stabs a funk figure over the kit; with a song playing in over USB, a held chord stabs on every one of its kick…

presets.name: Italo Disco
presets.blurb: Italo disco: a bright poly stab arpeggiating in sixteenths over a 909 four-on-the-floor, with a bell pluck on the harp echoing on the dotted eighth. A hand over the plate throws the stabs into a huge hall. Double tap and the arpeggio jumps an octave for the chorus.

presets.name: Radio DJ
presets.blurb: Play DJ with whatever is on your phone, coming in over USB (USB audio 1). Hold a chord and the harp strums it along with the song, down on the beat and up between; the pad's filter opens on the song's hats. Lower a hand over the plate to sink the song into a low pass, hold the modifier too for a hi…

presets.name: Blade Runner
presets.blurb: A big brass pad that swells open, with a vowel in it the hovering hand shades from ah to oo, drifting a little, sliding from chord to chord when fingers roll from one onto the next. The harp is a lead that swells as you press, the aftertouch of the old polysynths, and slides as you tap beside a hel…

presets.name: Berlin School
presets.blurb: A Tangerine Dream sequence: tap hold and the chord buttons run a two-bar line through the chord's notes, resonant and echoing, the hovering hand sweeping its filter. Play a lead over it on the harp, with a dotted-eighth echo and slides when you tap beside a held note. Double tap to loop eight bars…

presets.name: Power Ballad
presets.blurb: An eighties power ballad: a wide pad on the chord buttons, a sampled electric piano in a big hall on the harp, and a slow beat on an 808 with a gated room on the drums. A hand over the plate sends the pad into the arena. Tap the modifier and hold it down and the chords turn to suspensions for as lo…

banksets.title: World
banksets.author: Key & Cable
banksets.description: Twelve instruments from around the world, one for each bank, each in the tuning and the groove it is played in, travelling west to east as the banks go up: a forró accordion, a steel pan, Highland pipes, a klezmer clarinet, a kora, desert blues, an oud in maqam Rast, then three ragas through the day (Bhairav at dawn, Yaman at dusk, Darbari at midnight), a gamelan and a koto.

presets.name: Forro Accordion
presets.blurb: Forró from the northeast of Brazil: an accordion on the harp, its reeds beating as a musette does, playing the mixolydian of each chord; the chord buttons are the accordion's bass side, oom-pah in rhythm mode over a baião on hand percussion. Hold a note and tap the next for the ornaments. Double ta…

presets.blurb: From gen3, as it is there.

presets.name: Klezmer Clarinet
presets.blurb: A klezmer clarinet in freygish, the mode with the flat second and the major third, crying and trilling on hammer-ons and swelling as you press, over a tsimbl strumming the chords and a freylekhs dance in rhythm mode. Double tap for Mi Sheberakh, the other klezmer mode, its fourth raised.

presets.name: Kora
presets.blurb: A kora from Mali: bright, long-ringing strings that alternate from side to side as the kora's two rows of strings alternate between the hands, in Sauta, the tuning with the raised fourth. In rhythm mode the chord buttons pick the kumbengo, the bass ostinato a kora player keeps going under the runs,…

Hold a note and tap beside it for the krintan, the sitar's hammer-ons and pull-offs. The chord buttons swell the sitar's s…
